_: The wall. Edit this, then run: node tools/build-wall.js  (it rewrites #wall in index.html). The wall hangs freeform: main.js measures each frame and packs it into the columns by height, so there is no band rule to keep flush. Bands below are authoring groups only; their notes are history. Sizes are width hints for photographs and interactive tiles on the 12-column wall: wide 2/12, wide3 4/12, tall 2/12, lg 4/12, wx a standard 2/12 tile, none 2/12. The name card is 4/12. Games are portrait posters, always 2/12, and ignore the size hint; a 3:4 image at images/posters/<game>.jpg is used instead of the thumbnail and carries its own title, otherwise the thumbnail is cropped 3:4 and the title is written on it. Add framed:true to hang a game as a landscape photograph in a frame instead. Photos never carry a caption. A game is {game, title, caption?: false, framed?: true} | a photo is {photo, img, alt, title, size?, landscape?: true} | an interactive tile is {html: partial name in wall/partials/, size?}.
